description: Branch C, deciding variant: an indexed comparison against a residual (expression-only) comparison of negative DATE payloads. Dts has no index on D and DtsI has IX_DtsI_D (both built from the same seven payloads -1.5 to 45000.5). Asks, for each table, D = CDate(-0.25), D = #12/30/1899 06:00#, D BETWEEN #12/29/1899# AND #12/31/1899#, D < 0, D > -1.3, CDbl(D) = -0.25 (residual only), and ORDER BY D, listing the selected ids in order. Follow-up probe (status F) for Branch C; runs on a read-only open of fixture r-q-expr-sql-main through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one.

DROP TABLE RqNoSuchMarker

DROP TABLE RqNoSuchMarker
